name: iMessage Generator
summary: Insert an iMessage-style chat conversation overlay into the current Draft, with optional synced text-to-speech narration (free local Kokoro voices or ElevenLabs cloud voices).

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel SDK runScript/runShell/call, generated-media authoring, and Project file-tree adapters. Released-version and Windows/Linux compatibility are unverified.

ko.name: iMessage 생성기
ko.summary: 현재 초안에 iMessage 스타일 대화 오버레이를 넣고, 필요하면 싱크된 TTS 내레이션도 추가합니다(무료 로컬 Kokoro 음성 또는 ElevenLabs 클라우드 음성).
